svg.title: From problem statement to pattern, in five moves
svg.desc: Five step method for coding interviews: clarify constraints, work a small example by hand, state the brute force and why it times out, name the pattern that removes the repeated work, then code it and state time and space complexity.

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: CODING INTERVIEW

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: From problem statement to pattern, in five moves

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The signal in the question decides the pattern. Recognition is the skill being scored.

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clarify — input size, ranges, duplicates, sorted?

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: n = 10⁵ rules out O(n²). n = 20 is quietly inviting exponential. Two minutes here

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: prevents a wrong solution.

svg.text: Work a small example by hand, out loud

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The structure usually reveals itself on the smallest interesting case — not in your

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: head.

Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: State the brute force AND why it times out

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: "Two nested loops, O(n²). At n = 100,000 that is 10¹⁰ operations." Skipping this

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: reads as memorisation.

Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Name the pattern the signal triggers

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: "Sorted array, find a pair summing to a target — two pointers." Naming it is the

text.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: moment the interviewer relaxes.

text.font-family: Noteworthy, 'Bradley Hand', 'Segoe Print', 'Comic Sans MS', cursive

svg.text: name it!

svg.text: Code it talking, then state time AND space

svg.text: Then test: empty input, one element, all duplicates, target not present.
